Question: As Salam alaikum. I Recently came across a question from my friend, he asked me the following. Here (some ppl) invite for food, for the food which is cooked on some one else name i.e GairulAllah. My Question is that ppl who go and eat do they lose their Imaan due to eating? such Haram food? and also ppl who cooked and served such food lose their Imaan? Spme ppl knowing that the food is cooked on some one else name go and eat. what is the Islamic Ruling on This Could you please Explain. Thank you very much for helping the Ummah understand Shariah. Jazak'Allah Answer ID: 7449 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1629/1397=B/1429) It is absolutely unlawful and haram to slaughter animal or to cook food and feed it in the name of other than Allah, one who involves in such acts is sinner, his Eiman will remain intact but he will be utterly sinful. Such a person must repent sincerely to Allah and seek His forgiveness. In future, he must not observe any act in the name of anyone except Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
